title: Crocodile
author: rafaelrafi (@rafaelrafi)
notes: Nile-crocodile style. Hand-named bones (Hips, Spine1-4, Head, Arm*_R/L with finger bones, Leg*, Tail*). File is 16 MB, mostly textures. (97 bones total; 16.3 MB.)

title: Realistic Animated Bear 3D Model
author: WildMesh 3D (@WildMesh_3D)
notes: Brown bear. Bones use a Rig* prefix (RigPelvis, RigSpine1, RigNeck, RigHead, RigLBLeg/RigRBLeg = back legs, front legs, tail). Contains 81 animations, which is why the file is 14 MB. (37 bones total; 14.0 MB.)

title: Low Poly Dragon (Rigged)
author: Yanez Designs (@Yanez-Designs)
notes: Four legs and two wings, short-ish neck, crude low-poly look (best available: other rigged dragons were wyverns, cartoon, or copies of game dragons). Despite the title the .glb has NO skin; it is built from separate named mesh parts instead, which can be tinted directly: Body, Neck, Head, Tail, Left_wing, Right_wing, Left_arm, Left_leg, Right_leg, Right_leg001 (the front-right leg). Its one animation moves those parts. (0.2 MB.)

title: Black giant spider | Arana gigante negra
author: Josean_3dev (@Josean_3dev)
notes: Eight legs. Bone names are Spanish: Cabeza = head, Torso_Medio/Torso_bajo = body/abdomen, L./R.pa..pd = legs a-d per side, _01.._03 = leg segments. 4 animations. (29 bones total; 1.3 MB.)

title: Ball python
author: bluekiwi.dog (@bluekiwi.dog)
notes: Small coiled python (author describes it as a baby). Bones are a generic chain (Bone, Bone.001 ... Bone.023) with no head/tail names; one end of the chain is the head. Also has morph targets. (27 bones total; 1.1 MB.)

title: Slime
author: Quaternius
notes: Gel blob with eyes and small arms. Bones: Root, Body, Neck, Head, eyes, Shoulder/LowerArm/Hand L and R. 4 animations. (12 bones total; 0.2 MB.)

title: Running Tiger
author: Amil (francescolima74) (@francescolima74)
notes: 3ds Max Biped bones (Bip01 Pelvis/Spine/Neck/Head, L/R UpperArm = front legs, Thigh/Calf/HorseLink/Foot = back legs, Tail*). Bip01 Ponytail1/2 are ear bones. The same 4,650-triangle tiger has been uploaded by several users; this 2019 upload is the earliest, but authorship could not be confirmed. (47 bones total; 2.0 MB.)

title: Lion
author: doizy (@doizy)
notes: Male lion with mane. 3ds Max Biped bones (Bip01-Pelvis, Spine, Neck, Head, L/R limbs, tail) with numeric suffixes added by Sketchfab. (37 bones total; 1.8 MB.)

title: Leopard Animation Run
author: GremorySaiyan (@GremorySaiyan)
notes: 3ds Max Biped bones (Bip01_Pelvis, Spine, Neck, Head, limbs, tail). One run animation. (47 bones total; 1.0 MB.)

title: Hyena
author: SleepyPineapple (@SleepyPineapple)
notes: Spotted hyena, sculpted by the author. NOT rigged (no skeleton) and made of 2 unnamed meshes, so it cannot be split by bone. No rigged hyena with a trustworthy licence was found. 9.8 MB, mostly textures. (9.8 MB.)

title: Shiba Inu
author: Quaternius
notes: Medium dog from the Quaternius Animated Animal Pack. Clear bone names (Body, Torso, Neck1-3, Head, Ear*, legs, tail). 24 animations. (46 bones total; 0.9 MB.)

title: Komodo
author: denys4624 (@denys4624)
notes: Komodo dragon. NOT rigged (no skeleton); made of 41 unnamed mesh pieces (Object_3, Object_4, ...), so it cannot be split by bone or by part name. No rigged Komodo or monitor with a trustworthy licence was found. A later identical re-upload by another user exists; this is the earliest (2021). (2.7 MB.)

title: 【Anime Character】Arisa (Free / Unity 3D)
author: 3D Anime Character Store (@alex94i60)
notes: Anime-style girl (made in VRoid) for the human figure. Clear humanoid bones: Hips, Spine, Chest, Neck, Head, Left/Right shoulder-arm-elbow-wrist, Left/Right leg-knee-ankle-toe, plus finger, hair and skirt bones. T-pose, no animations. 23k triangles. (96 bones total; 5.9 MB.)

title: Streer Fighter Juri Han T pose
author: lawlietrecluze (@lawlietrecluze)
notes: Original file: streer-fighter-juri-han-t-pose.zip > source/Hi3D_Stylized Muscular Juri Han 3D Fighting Game Character_allpa.glb. AI-generated (Hi3D) scan: one single mesh, NO skeleton (cannot be split by bone), 2,000,000 triangles and about 60 MB with 2 embedded textures; it will need rigging and decimating before use. Shipped unedited; the zip also had loose copies of the same textures, which are not included. The uploader labels it CC-BY, but it is fan art of a copyrighted character (Juri Han from Street Fighter, Capcom); the licence cannot cover the character design itself, so keep it for personal use only.
